metadata.description: reims-vgpu is an experimental virtual GPU for macOS guests

latest_default_branch_commit.relevance: README currently says Beta and details the translated guest command stream, host pathways, guest test matrix, and license terms.

readme_claims.status: Beta; largely stabilized, with remaining host/GPU-driver differences.
readme_claims.implementation: Replaces ParavirtualizedGraphics.framework; implements QEMU apple-gfx guest-GPU command handling; guest AppleParavirtGPU.kext is unchanged and no separate guest driver is installed.
targets: arm64 macOS guest on Apple Silicon macOS host using Metal
x86_64 macOS guest on x86_64 Linux/KVM using Vulkan through metal2vulkan
optional Apple Silicon Vulkan path through MoltenVK
maintainer_reported_tests: arm64 macOS 13, 14, 15 and 26 on M3 Max
x86_64 macOS 26 on Linux with RTX 5080 laptop GPU
readme_claims.boundary: This is a VM guest paravirtual-GPU interface bridge. It does not establish application-level Metal, Direct3D or OpenGL compatibility.

license.note: The README and Cargo workspace state this dual option; QEMU and linked dependencies retain their own terms. GitHub license detector returned NOASSERTION.

metadata.description: Experimental host-side Metal compute API prototype with a Vulkan executor and offline parity research.

latest_default_branch_commit.relevance: Latest commit is a documentation correction; repository metadata has no GitHub releases.

readme_claims.implementation: Rust source-level Metal-shaped compute objects; metal-api-vulkan routes accepted AIR-based workloads through a pinned metal2vulkan revision; a native Metal provider supports parity experiments.
targets: Windows GNU/Vulkan smoke and RTX 5060 provider evidence
readme_claims.boundary: Explicitly not a Metal.framework ABI implementation. It cannot load arbitrary macOS Objective-C/Swift binaries; substantial API and production integration features remain unimplemented. Optional reims VM work uses an independent/local adapter.

license.note: COPYING carries GPL-3 text incorporated by the LGPL terms; NOTICE identifies third-party and local reims-adapter terms. GitHub license field is LGPL-3.0 and page detects both LGPL-3.0 and GPL-3.0 files.
